title: Симуляция ОГЭ (Устная часть Task 2)
description: Симуляция устной части ОГЭ Task 2: ответь экзаменатору на вопросы о своём прошлом (готовый ответ — на экране).
task_context: Act like an examiner for the Russian OGE exam (Task 2). Ask me questions about my past weekend.

checklist.question: What were you doing at 5 PM yesterday?
checklist.hint: I was doing my homework at 5 pm yesterday.

checklist.question: What did you do last weekend?
checklist.hint: I did nothing special. I chatted with my friend and watched a new film.

checklist.question: Were you studying when I called you?
checklist.hint: Yes, I was preparing for my test in English.

checklist.question: What were you doing when the electricity went out?
checklist.hint: When the electricity went out, I was surfing the net.
